philosophy: Do NOT read numbers. Recognize people. Cluster first, label later.

phase_1_clustering.name: Unsupervised Grouping (0-5min, NO OCR)
steps: 1. Track all players as anonymous IDs (track_001, track_002...)
2. Record on-ice sets per shift: which 5 tracks appear together
3. After 4-6 shifts, cluster co-occurrence: 3 forward lines + 2-3 D-pairs emerge
4. Within each forward line: faceoff position = Center, left side = LW, right side = RW
5. Within each D-pair: left position = LD, right position = RD
6. Bench exit position tracks which line number (1st/2nd/3rd)
7. Result: every player assigned to group + role, zero OCR

signals.shot_hand: Compare wrist keypoints 9,10 y-position. left_wrist.y < right_wrist.y = RIGHT shot. One frame enough. Never changes.
signals.body_shape: Via homography: height = head-to-ankle meters. shoulder_width = shoulder_L to shoulder_R. leg_ratio = hip-ankle / shoulder-hip. Update running average.
signals.equipment: Split bbox into 5 horizontal zones: helmet(top 15%), shoulders(15-30%), torso(30-55%), pants(55-80%), skates(bottom 20%). HSV histogram per zone. Skates most reliable: always black on white ice, brand differences visible.
signals.motion_dna: Collect 10-frame pose keypoint sequences during skating. Each sequence = 170-dim vector. Build per-player embedding via simple cosine similarity. No training needed initially.
signals.position_behavior: Cumulative zone heatmap per player. D: blue_line_ratio > 0.35. F: attack_zone_entries > 3 per shift. C: faceoff_participation. LW/RW: lateral_bias.

phase_3_labeling.name: Minimal OCR Labeling (5-10min)
steps: 1. From phase_1, we have N clusters (player groups)
2. For each cluster, find the single BEST torso crop: largest bbox + pose shows back + minimal motion blur + no occlusion
3. Run OCR on ONLY this best crop (1 per player, not thousands)
4. If OCR succeeds: label entire cluster with that number
5. If OCR fails: use roster matching via signals (shot_hand + position + height narrows to 1-2 candidates)
6. Roster constraint: if 4 of 5 on-ice identified, 5th = automatic
7. Total OCR attempts needed: 5-10 for entire team, not 5000

phase_4_classifier.name: Game-Specific Visual Classifier (10min+)
steps: 1. Phase 3 produced labeled crops for each player
2. Each player has 10-50 torso crops from phase 2 collection
3. Fine-tune ResNet18 on these crops: N classes = N players
4. Training: ~2min on Mac Mini M4 MPS
5. This classifier replaces OCR for rest of game
6. NOT reading digits. Matching visual pattern of entire torso.

phase_5_maintenance.name: Continuous Tracking (10min-60min)
phase_5_maintenance.line_change_handling: When new players enter ice: match against existing profiles (equipment + body + motion). If line structure changed, detect via new co-occurrence pattern. Individual profiles survive line changes.
phase_5_maintenance.opponent_handling: Same pipeline but no roster. Build roster progressively. unknown_A stays tracked, gets number when OCR succeeds. Retroactive relabeling of all past data.
phase_5_maintenance.error_correction: If two signals disagree (OCR says 47 but height says 14), flag for re-evaluation. Use confidence-weighted Bayesian fusion. Higher confidence signal wins.
